title: Tie your shoes
summary: Bunny-ears way to tie shoelaces, one little step at a time.
keywords: tie shoes shoelaces laces knot bow sneakers bunny ears lace up

steps.show: Make an X with the laces
steps.say: Grab one lace in each hand and cross them to make a big X.
steps.tip: Hold the laces near the ends. One goes over the other, like a little X.

steps.say: Now tuck the top lace under the other one, and pull both tight.
steps.tip: Push the top lace down through the middle of the X, then pull the ends apart.

steps.say: Make a loop with one lace. That's bunny ear number one!
steps.tip: Fold the lace in half like a hairpin and pinch the bottom.

steps.say: Make a loop with the other lace. Bunny ear number two!
steps.tip: Same as the first one. Now you have two bunny ears.

steps.say: Cross the two bunny ears into an X.
steps.tip: Lay one bunny ear over the other one.

steps.say: Tuck the top bunny ear under and through the hole at the bottom.
steps.tip: It's the same move as step two, just with the loops. Down and through!

steps.say: Pull both bunny ears tight. Ta-da, a bow!
steps.tip: Pull slowly and hold the loops, not the ends.

title: Brush your teeth
summary: Two minutes of brushing, top, bottom, insides and tongue.
keywords: brush teeth toothbrush toothpaste brushing mouth clean teeth dentist floss

steps.say: Squeeze a tiny bit of toothpaste on your brush. Just a pea-sized blob.
steps.tip: Smaller than a grape. Like one little pea!

steps.say: Brush your top teeth with tiny circles, all the way to the back.
steps.tip: Go slow, like you're drawing little bubbles on each tooth.

steps.say: Now the bottom teeth. Little circles again!
steps.tip: Start on one side and walk the brush to the other side.

steps.say: Tilt the brush and brush the insides of your teeth too.
steps.tip: The side that touches your tongue. They like to be clean too!

steps.say: Scrub the flat chewing tops, back and forth.
steps.tip: The big bumpy teeth in the back. Scrub scrub scrub.

steps.say: Give your tongue a gentle brush. Tickly!
steps.tip: Just a soft brush, from back to front.

steps.say: Spit it out and rinse your brush. Sparkly!
steps.tip: Spit in the sink, then rinse the brush under the water.

title: Draw a cat
summary: Draw a cute cat from simple shapes: circle, triangles, and lines.
keywords: draw a cat drawing kitty kitten art picture sketch doodle animal

steps.say: Draw a big circle. That's the cat's head!
steps.tip: It doesn't have to be perfect. Wobbly circles are cute.

steps.say: Add two pointy triangle ears on top.
steps.tip: One on the left and one on the right, like little mountains.

steps.say: Draw two eyes in the middle of the head.
steps.tip: Two dots or two little circles. Make them look happy!
steps.draw: <circle cx='84' cy='90' r='6' class='fill'/><circle cx='116' cy='90' r='6' class='fill'/>

steps.say: Put a tiny upside-down triangle nose under the eyes.
steps.tip: Point the triangle down, right in the middle.

steps.say: Under the nose, draw a mouth like a little letter W.
steps.tip: Two little curves hanging down from the nose.

steps.say: Add whiskers! Three lines on each side.
steps.tip: Start near the nose and draw lines going out, like sun rays.

steps.say: Draw a round body under the head, and a curly tail. Meow!
steps.tip: A big U shape for the body, then a swoosh for the tail.

title: Pack your backpack
summary: Get your school bag ready the night before, so mornings are easy.
keywords: pack backpack school bag schoolbag get ready for school homework folder lunch pencil case

steps.say: Put your homework folder in first, flat against the back.
steps.tip: Flat things go in the back so they don't get squished.

steps.say: Now slide in your books and notebooks.
steps.tip: Big ones first, little ones in front.

steps.say: Pop in your pencil case.
steps.tip: Is it zipped? Then no pencils escape!

steps.say: Put your snack in, and your water bottle in the side pocket.
steps.tip: The side pocket is the stretchy one on the outside.

steps.say: Anything to give your teacher? Like a note or a form? Put it in the folder.
steps.tip: Check the kitchen table or the fridge for notes.

steps.show: Zip it and hang it up
steps.say: Zip it up and put it by the door. You're ready for tomorrow!
steps.tip: By the door means you can't forget it in the morning.

title: Wash your hands
summary: Soap, scrub for twenty seconds, rinse and dry.
keywords: wash hands handwashing soap clean hands germs sink

steps.say: Turn on the water and get your hands wet.
steps.tip: Warm or cold water both work.

steps.say: Put some soap on your hands.
steps.tip: One pump is plenty.

steps.say: Scrub everywhere for twenty seconds! Backs, between your fingers, and under your nails.
steps.tip: Sing Happy Birthday two times. That's twenty seconds!

steps.say: Rinse all the bubbles off.
steps.tip: Hold your hands under the water till the bubbles are gone.

steps.say: Dry your hands on a towel. Squeaky clean!
steps.tip: Pat pat pat, till they're dry.

title: Make your bed
summary: Straighten the sheet and blanket, then pillow on top.
keywords: make bed making the bed tidy room blanket sheets pillow bedroom chores

steps.say: Pull the sheet up to the top of the bed and smooth it out.
steps.tip: Swoosh your hands across it to get the bumps out.

steps.say: Now pull the blanket up over it.
steps.tip: Grab the top corners and pull toward the pillow.

steps.say: Smooth it flat, like ironing with your hands.
steps.tip: Start in the middle and push the wrinkles out to the sides.

steps.say: Fluff your pillow and put it at the top. Bed boss!
steps.tip: Give it a little punch to fluff it up.

title: Play Rock Paper Scissors
summary: Learn the three hand shapes and who beats who.
keywords: rock paper scissors game play a game hand game roshambo

steps.say: Rock is a fist. Make a rock!
steps.tip: Squeeze your hand into a ball.

steps.say: Paper is a flat hand. Make paper!
steps.tip: Open your hand wide and flat, like a pancake.

steps.say: Scissors are two fingers, like a peace sign. Snip snip!
steps.tip: Just your pointer finger and middle finger.

steps.say: Rock smashes scissors. Scissors cut paper. And paper covers rock.
steps.tip: Each one beats one and loses to one. It's a circle!

steps.say: Now play with a grown-up! Say rock, paper, scissors, shoot, and show your hand.
steps.tip: Everyone shows their hand at the same time on shoot.

title: Play I Spy
summary: A looking game: give a color clue and friends guess the thing.
keywords: i spy game play a game guessing game look colors

steps.say: Look around and pick something you can see. Keep it a secret!
steps.tip: Pick something big enough for everyone to see.

steps.say: Say, I spy with my little eye, something that is, and then its color.
steps.tip: Like: I spy something that is blue.

steps.say: Let your friends guess. Say yes or no to each guess.
steps.tip: If they're stuck, give one more clue, like its shape.

steps.say: Whoever guesses it gets the next turn!
steps.tip: Now you get to be the guesser.
